english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for making someone act, and it also covers causing a reluctant reaction such as a laugh or smile.
Use this as the all-purpose spoken choice when a person or circumstance forces someone to act.
This is the all-purpose spoken choice when someone is forced or pressured to do something.
Use this when pressing means forcing, driving someone back, or putting strong pressure on someone to accept or do something.
Use this when someone is compelled or pushed hard to do something through pressure or force.
Use this when causing someone to do something is forceful or coercive, making them act against their will.

examples.english: They force me to agree immediately.
examples.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 bik1 ngo5 zik1 hak1 daap3 jing3

examples.english: They compel me to hand in the report today.
examples.traditional: 佢逼我今日一定要交份報告。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 bik1 ngo5 gam1 jat6 jat1 ding6 jiu3 gaau1 fan6 bou3 gou3

examples.english: My boss used pressure to oblige me to work late today.
examples.traditional: 老闆逼我今日返工返到好夜。
examples.jyutping: lou5 baan2 bik1 ngo5 gam1 jat6 faan1 gung1 faan1 dou3 hou2 je6
